preconditions: The selected UART must already be configured with the expected baud rate.
Any optional PPS signal should be routed before use.
steps: Open the UART channel at the configured default baud rate.
Read an NMEA or UBX frame to confirm the receiver is alive.
Optionally configure update rate or output sentence policy.

checks: Confirm UART receive traffic from the receiver.
If wired, observe PPS transitions or a stable idle level.
smokeTest.passCriteria: The receiver emits valid serial traffic on the configured UART.
failureNotes: A lack of fix is not the same as a communication failure.
Indoor or shielded use can prevent a position lock while the UART link is still healthy.

highLevel.name: gnss_read_frame
highLevel.description: Read raw NMEA or UBX frames from the receiver.

highLevel.name: gnss_get_fix
highLevel.description: Return the latest parsed position and timing solution.

highLevel.name: gnss_configure_rate
highLevel.description: Apply a project-local navigation update rate.
